description.value: Salsa & Agave is a well-established Mexican restaurant on Pacific Boulevard in Vancouver, serving authentic dishes including tacos, enchiladas, birria, pozole, and margaritas for over a decade. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating in a relaxed atmosphere and is praised by regulars for consistent food quality and friendly service. Online ordering and takeout are available, making it a convenient mid-ride fuel stop in central Vancouver.
